**Daily Devotional**

**July 8**

*1 Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases. 2 And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick. (Luke 9:1-2 KJV)*

Notice that Jesus gave His disciples the power to not only cast out devils (demons), but also the power to cure all diseases and sicknesses. He later gave another 70 disciples the same power and sent them out (Luke 10). This same power is now available in all Christians who have been born again and have the baptism of the Holy Ghost (John 14:16-17), and are walking in the Spirit. Why Religion has decided to not walk in the full power of God, but to just go out and make converts, I don’t really know. If the original disciples needed the power of deliverance and healing to confirm the Word that they preached (Mark 16:20), then we most certainly need it today. The Lord never said to just make converts, but disciples (John 8:31).

Maybe, just maybe, the reason that the Church today is not making the difference in the world that the first century Church did is just because we do not show the power of God in our Churches. That could be one reason that so many people don’t see any need for being a Christian, as it doesn’t help them in this life, so they are not interested. If we would demonstrate God’s power in our Churches today, it would draw people just as it did in the days that Jesus walked on earth. Jesus told us to do the works that He did (John 14:12), and that includes healing and raising the dead. If we would all do that, then we would see a real revival occur. Thank you Lord for giving us your power.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
